scenes: Dorothy lived on the wide gray prairie of Kansas, with Aunt Em, Uncle Henry, and her little dog, Toto.
Everything here is so gray, Toto. But you always make me laugh!
A cyclone is coming! Everybody inside!
The wind lifted the whole house, up, up, up into the sky!
Oh, Toto. I don't think we're in Kansas anymore!
Hooray! Welcome to the land of Oz!
Hello, Dorothy. I am Glinda, the Good Witch.
Please, how can I get home?
Wear these silver shoes, and follow the road of yellow bricks to the Emerald City. The great Wizard of Oz can help you.
Excuse me! Could you help me down?
Thank you! I wish I had a brain. My head is full of straw.
Come with us! Maybe the Wizard can give you one.
An oil can? Here you go!
Ahh, I can move again! Thank you. I wish I had a heart.
Then come with us to see the Wizard!
Oh, please don't bark at me! I'm just a scaredy-cat. I wish I had courage.
Don't cry, Lion. Come with us! The Wizard can help you too.
Side by side, the friends walked down the road of yellow bricks.
I am Oz, the Great and Mighty! Why have you come?
Please, I want to go home. And my friends want a brain, a heart, and courage.
First, make the Wicked Witch of the West go away!
Fly, my monkeys! Bring me that girl and her silver shoes!
The Winged Monkeys carried Dorothy and Toto away to the yellow castle.
And I'll be brave, for Dorothy!
Hee hee! That silver shoe is mine!
Toto knocked over a screen, and there was the Wizard: just a little old man!
I'm sorry, my friends. But you don't need me. Scarecrow, you made a clever plan. Tin Woodman, you cried for your friend. Lion, you were so brave.
You had it inside you all along!
Dorothy, your silver shoes can take you home. Just click your heels three times.
Goodbye, my friends. I'll miss you so much!
Take me home to Aunt Em!
Oh, Aunt Em! Oz was wonderful... but there's no place like home.
